notes: the four Companions after «عن» are alternatives in one level (rule 2): «كل هؤلاء سمعوا من رسول الله» is their claim, and the Prophet is the end of the chain
the dual nisba «الدمشقيان» stands with the second name of the pair
«حدثني أبو عبد الله الأشعري» continues the chain from Abu Salih; the Ash'ari names are left as written
